content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Sacramento

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Document your work history, education, and any prior certifications. Verify you meet these baseline requirements before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous sessions over several days or weeks—no self-paced modules. Active certified practitioners lead the course content aligned to PMI's exam outline, preparing you directly for the certification exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35-hour course, apply through PMI's official portal. Upload proof of your education, work experience, and contact-hour completion certificate from Granite PM Academy. Pay the examination fee directly to PMI to activate your exam eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, review sessions, and study guides—to reinforce bootcamp material. Schedule your exam at a PMI-authorized testing center. The exam tests your command of project-management processes, inputs, tools, and outputs across all knowledge areas.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you earn the PMP credential valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, certifications, publications, or volunteer work. Renew your credential before expiration to keep it active and demonstrate ongoing expertise.
